what: Labelled compass frames. truth_deg is the heading at the view centre, in degrees, 0=N 90=E.

how_truth_was_established.L+T: Two or more distinct letters recognised over the full threshold ladder, at a pitch measured from the TICK LATTICE rather than from the letters, all implying the same heading once snapped to the tick phase.
how_truth_was_established.L+T+R: As L+T, and the frame also sits inside a run of frames over which the recorded controller never moved the right stick out of its deadzone (demos/*/input.json, ~50Hz, on the frames' own time base). Only the right stick turns the camera, so the heading cannot have changed across such a run, and every frame in it must read the same. 725 of 726 letter-truth frames inside such a run agreed with their run to within 3 degrees.
how_truth_was_established.R: No letters could be established on this frame, but it lies inside such a run and takes the run's heading.

frames.why: THE REGRESSION ANCHOR. The only letter the blob sweep recognises at the first qualifying threshold is the E at 711.5, read as 'W'. Baseline reports 264.92 against a truth of 84.82 -- 179.9 degrees wrong, and stable enough that the next frame agrees with it.
A blob at 572.0 that is not a letter at all (the letters are at 499.5, 711.7, 924.0) is read as 'S' and, being the only one, is believed: 233.00 against a truth of 84.82.

A third wrong value from the same static scene: the single letter used is a 'W' at 572.0 -- again a position where no letter stands -- giving 324.00 against a truth of 84.82. The same frame carries a correct E at 711.5 and S at 920.5, so it proves its own label without leaning on the propagated segment heading.
A clean three-letter frame at the demo capture size: N 494.8, E 706.8, S 919.5, tick spacing 23.61 so 9d = 212.5 -- the same pitch the letters measure.

The calibration frame for the tick geometry. S 615.0, W 906.4, N 1198.0; ticks 32.394 apart at rms 0.200px, so 9d = 291.55 against 291.5 from the letters, and each letter sits within 0.14px of a half-lattice node.
Two letters, N and E, at the live capture size.
read_bearing abstains; the full threshold sweep finds S and N and the tick lattice agrees. Recoverable coverage at the live geometry.
The other 1920x1080 frame read_bearing abstains on that has established truth.
A single-letter read at the live geometry that is CORRECT (159.93 vs 160.33). This is what REQUIRE_TWO_LETTERS costs -- 10 such frames of 366 at 1920x1080, none of them wrong.
Another correct single-letter read at the live geometry.
